name: Newtrac Foods & Beverages Limited
about: NEWTRAC FOODS & BEVERAGES LIMITED does not have significant operations. Previously, the company was involved in manufacturing, bleaching, dyeing, printing, and knitting in high pile fur fabrics, cloth, and other fabrics made from acrylic, polyester, cotton silk, artificial silk, wool, and other materials. It intends to manufacture texturized yarn, cotton yarn, and textiles products. The company was formerly known as Markobenz Ventures Limited and changed its name to NEWTRAC FOODS & BEVERAGES LIMITED in July 2025. NEWTRAC FOODS & BEVERAGES LIMITED was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.
